prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Companion", "Select a companion style and review key personality traits before proceeding."]
1: ["Initializing Desktop Pet Engine", "Verifying screen overlay permissions and asset rendering...", "Desktop overlay initialized. Preparing pet assets..."]
2: ["Desktop Pet Quick Controls", "Right-click your pet anytime to access options, or use these simple desktop shortcuts.", "Got It!"]
3: ["Meet Your Virtual Desktop Buddy", "Your companion lives directly on your desktop screen, reacting to your day and keeping you company.", "Get Started"]
4: ["Signing in with your account automatically restores your previously adopted pets and cloud progress."]
5: ["Review Your Companion Details", "Confirm your companion's traits before we generate the official adoption certificate.", "Confirm & Adopt"]
6: []
7: ["How Would You Like to Select Your Pet?", "Choose a pre-made companion for quick setup, or create a custom pet tailored to your photos.", "You can add more pets later from your desktop menu."]
8: ["Welcome Your Pet to the Desktop!", "Complete these quick steps to get familiar with your new companion.", "Finish Setup"]
9: ["Cloud Save Active: Keeps your pet safe across updates"]
